summary: Add a second request source to packages/envoy/loadtest (built on legion/INFRA-589, PR sjawhar/legion#2369) that replays LINUX's 22:55-23:34Z write log as the dispatch CLI 10.25.1 sends each write, on a seed of LINUX's state at 22:55:00Z reconstructed from production's per-issue event logs, built once at migration 0114 by 35efd326 plus an allocation-free len16 patch and distributed as <=24 MiB Dispatch artifacts on INFRA-639 with a committed manifest of sha256 values (no private data in the public repository). Runs restore the seed into a template, migrate it forward per Dispatch build (LOADTEST_DISPATCH_COMMIT builds only Dispatch from another commit), and record F, reads, uploads share, GOMAXPROCS, seed sha, /proc CPU-seconds over the window, cores at the full rate, saturation and window heap profiles.

branch.start: legion/INFRA-639@origin, which the daemon created at main 59f6647d; legion/INFRA-589 does not contain that commit, so the branch cannot be reset onto it without a force push
branch.integration: first implementer step: forward-merge legion/INFRA-589@origin (a30d1f50 at planning time) into legion/INFRA-639; merge it again after each of its pushes; merge main after #2369 merges; PR base is main and its body names this issue's commits until #2369 merges

tasks: 1. Forward-merge legion/INFRA-589@origin into legion/INFRA-639 (no force push); PR base main.

2. loadgen replay-fetch (read-only production, <=4 concurrent): state at 22:55:00Z from per-issue event logs, docs at their 22:55 version, window events, created-doc v1 contents, roster ids; unit tests of reconstruction and issue-level sampling; upload bundle parts to INFRA-639; manifest packages/envoy/loadtest/replay-2026-10-26.json.

3. Seed: replay-seed-len16.patch with equivalence test over every bundle text and a 20-document pilot logical-dump comparison stock vs patched; loadgen replay-seed (history edits first, then comments in original order, resolved roots only when the window refers to them, fallback unique quotes, statuses/claims last; ids in loadtest.replay_ids; resumable); stack.sh replay-seed (35efd326 + patch, quiesce, vacuum, pg_dump, split); pilot projection to the architect before the full seed; replay-check-seed; upload parts; complete manifest.

4. stack.sh replay-get (sha256-verified download, restore template dispatch_replay_seed), replay-prepare per Dispatch binary sha (migrate from 0114, wait backfill tables and quiet check, keep dispatch_replay_<key>, at most 3), logical checksum per reset, LOADTEST_DISPATCH_COMMIT build of envoy-dispatch only (GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local, self-contained pprof overlay when cmd/dispatch/pprof.go is absent), LOADTEST_GOMAXPROCS; start 35efd326 on the stack and record what it needs.

5. runReplay beside runRequests (one branch in execute): transaction grouping, the per-write request table in plan.md D7, diff-derived or size-tracking substitute edits, U split, issue-level sampling at F by hash(rng-seed, key), sub-window, rho reads with mix, one connection and a 60 s deadline per action, 762-session roster (~458 B each) with heartbeat, 2 SSE streams; loadgen replay-plan dry run; unit tests.

6. Per-run record: /proc reads and heap-start/heap-end profiles at the window bounds, summary.json replay block (inputs, window_s, dispatch_cpu_s, cores_full_rate, idle and idle-corrected, drain_cpu_s, planned/sent/failed per kind, substitutes, in-flight, timeouts, saturated), TABLES.md Replay table, LOADTEST_PG_DIRECT=1 default for replay.

7. run-step.sh --replay flags; README section (inputs, manifest, one run, the merge rule's six runs, heap diff, summary fields, rebuilding bundle and seed, what is not reproduced); rewrite README.md:770-785; CHANGELOG; AGENTS.md row; check-private-names.sh clean.
8. When seed parts are uploaded and one replay run passes on the branch: tell the architect the commit and manifest so fix children measure from the branch.

9. Calibrate F at 35efd326 (0.05, 0.1, 0.15; default = largest not saturated); 3 runs at default F, rho 1, U 0.25, one rng seed; one at U 0 and one at U 0.5; one at main head; report cores at full rate beside 10.9-14.0, spread, U bracket, prepare time and the not-reproduced list in the PR body and replay-baseline-2026-10-27.md on INFRA-639.
10. Simplify pass, PR, CI; merge as soon as #2369 has merged.

specDepartures.spec: Acceptance 2: real-size LINUX specs, each carrying its own production count of open anchored comments (median 25, write-weighted mean 47) and of versions (median 28).
specDepartures.plan: Seed each document at its own count at 22:55:00Z, the window's start (open anchored: median 22, sum 10,179 over the 405 documents written; versions: each document's version number at 22:55), so the replayed window's own anchored comments bring documents to production's after-window counts.
specDepartures.evidence: prod-anchors-per-doc.json was read at about 03:10Z, after the window; subtracting the window's 1,495 anchored roots per document gives median 22 / sum 10,179 at 22:55. writes-state.md section 2: 'median 28' is the version number reached over the window's 1,355 version writes, not a median over documents. Seeding the after-window counts would put the window's anchored roots on top of them.

acceptance: 2: the seed's counts are each document's own counts at 22:55:00Z; the figures 25/47/28 describe production after the window

specDepartures.spec: Shared context: the Dispatch server run locally against Postgres 17 with pgvector.
specDepartures.plan: The load test's stack (INFRA-589) runs Postgres 16.2 with pgvector from the pgserver wheel; the seed is dumped and restored on 16.2 and the version is recorded.

risks: Seed time: about 20 h CPU on stock 35efd326 [INFERENCE: model], less with the len16 patch; many hours of wall time on a 2-core pod; the pilot measures it first; a pod deleted mid-seed loses its disk.
Whole-issue sampling makes CPU depend on which large issues are kept; one rng seed keeps base and head on the same work.
INFRA-589 is still changing; each push is merged in.
35efd326 may need environment differences on the stack; D6 records them.
